description: A yellow tabletop sits in front of a red cloth backdrop, with small plastic plates and colorful toy cutlery spread near the bottom right. The left hand enters from the left and waves over the table surface, as if wiping and clearing space, while the right hand reaches in from the right to touch and nudge the plate and utensils; the left hand is briefly a left-hand object with a cloth and the right hand is a right-hand object with the plate.
